profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend & Cloud Automation | C#/.NET, Node.js, Python, React | Identity & Security (Keycloak, Entra ID, SSO/RBAC/MFA)
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience across backend systems, cloud infrastructure automation, and full-stack development. I work primarily in C#/.NET, Node.js, Python, and React, with a track record of architecting cost-saving automation platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and identity/security infrastructure. My background spans healthcare (HIPAA-compliant systems), data center IaaS automation, and startup product development.
Most recently, I've been focused on AI-assisted engineering — using Claude Code (and ChatGPT for supporting research) to build CI/CD pipelines, create stakeholder-facing UI mockups, write system specs and data-flow diagrams, and run test-driven validation on critical production migrations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and deployed a self-hosted SSO solution (Keycloak) across our Node.js/React stack, replacing Auth0 — saving ~$15K/year while strengthening security with RBAC/MFA for HIPAA-compliant healthcare data.
Led the next-phase identity strategy: migrated SSO from self-hosted Keycloak to Microsoft Entra ID (aligned with our signed BAA with Microsoft), using AI-assisted (Claude Code) test-driven development to validate every user and data transfer for an error-free migration.

Took over UI/UX mockup and prototyping after our designer departed — using Claude Code to build stakeholder-facing mockups, author system specs, and create data-flow diagrams that reduced back-and-forth in code review.

Built CI/CD infrastructure with GitHub Actions and self-hosted runners, including automated ESLint/npm-audit security scans and Claude Code-based automated review, saving ~10 engineering hours/month.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
CloudHub IaaS Automation Platform: architected an automation solution (C#, .NET, REST APIs, MS-SQL, Redis, Terraform) delivering $90K/year in savings and a 70% reduction in deployment time.

Delivered a RESTful API (Python, Django, MS-SQL, Redis, API gateway) that increased throughput by 26%.
Built a network traffic monitoring system handling 160,000 QPS (InfluxDB, ntopng), contributing to a 12% 
increase in network services revenue.

B2C Sales Platform: led a microservices migration onto Kubernetes that cut call-chain complexity by 42%, and integrated VMware VCD data into a single dashboard, boosting customer satisfaction by 25%.

Improved database read performance by 30% (200ms → 140ms) and write performance by 22%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Reduced 70% of manual testing time by using Selenium to create automated testing scripts for web applications.

Reduced setup time by 50% by developing automated Hyper-V HA cluster settings using Powershell and C#.

Created chat service using RabbitMQ, C#, Wit Ai, allowing users to communicate with smart doorbell through text, control door lock, and register users.
